description: This file defines an abstract controller class 'BaseAdminController' for the OrangeHRM Admin plugin. It manages user role permissions, capability checks, and sets permissions into the Vue context, serving as a base class for specific admin controllers.

classes.name: BaseAdminController
classes.description: An abstract controller class providing role-based permission checking and Vue context integration for admin-related functionalities.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns an array of data group identifiers for permission checks.

methods.name: isCapable
methods.description: Checks if the current user has read permissions for the data groups relevant to this controller.

methods.name: setPermissionsForController
methods.description: Sets the permissions in the Vue context for use in the frontend interface.
